summary: CFTC_CME_BITCOIN_TFF_SOURCE_DESIGN_READY. Freeze only CFTC_CME_BITCOIN_TFF_FUTURES_ONLY_V1: Traders in Financial Futures, Futures Only; market BITCOIN - CHICAGO MERCANTILE EXCHANGE; contract market code 133741; fixed future locator https://www.cftc.gov/dea/newcot/FinFutWk.txt. The locator was not opened. A future zero-parameter producer must seal the complete raw response before parsing, require the official ordered 87-field shape, select exactly one identity-matching row, preserve raw suppression markers, and bind report date, contract/market/commodity codes, contract units and FutOnly marker. Tuesday close is observation time; availability is no earlier than the official Friday 3:30 p.m. America/New_York release or the versioned holiday-adjusted schedule. Only the existing daily 09:05 Asia/Taipei Cloud Ops cycle may check. Evidence becomes eligible only for the first existing DRA decision strictly after network-denied canonical intake accepts the sealed receipt, never the same decision/fill cycle. The immutable state machine is NO_NEW_REPORT, CONTRACT_ABSENT, DUPLICATE_CONTRACT_ROW, MALFORMED_REPORT, WRONG_REPORT_FAMILY, REPORT_DATE_IN_FUTURE, RELEASE_NOT_DUE, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, SAME_REPORT_BYTES_DRIFT and NEW_REPORT_SEALED. Same-date changed bytes are an integrity alert and cannot overwrite prior evidence. One-way hash-bound transport preserves Server Canonical as sole state writer. Government information may be reused with CFTC acknowledgement; privately supplied material and the CFTC seal are excluded. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effect are exactly zero; all predictive and economic value remains MISSING_PROOF.
